messages:
Ben Carter: Hey all — heads up we’re kicking off a focused Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint starting next week (activation + early retention for self-serve/PLG devs). This will touch onboarding emails + a couple in-console nudges + retargeting for non-activated / lapsed signups.

What’s changing (high level):
• Emails: welcome + quickstart + first-success + troubleshooting + “next step” (suppression + throttles in place)
• Console: setup checklist + 2 contextual banners (feature-flagged, gradual rollout)
• Ads: retargeting audiences + landing page variant (benchmarks + quickstart)

Success metrics we’ll track: activation within 24h/72h, time-to-first-success, D7/D14 retention, plus “higher intent” milestones (billing added, token usage ramp, deployment/route created, invite teammate).

Links:
• PRD (Confluence): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PROD/Lifecycle+Growth+Experiments+Sprint+PRD
• Experiment tracker (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/redwood-g2m/experiment-tracker (tab: Lifecycle Sprint)
• Event taxonomy (Confluence): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PROD/Event+Taxonomy+-+Activation+and+Retention

Where to report issues / feedback:
• Console bugs / regressions: drop in #product (tag @Marissa Cole / @Chloe Martin) and/or file Linear (Product > Activation)
• Analytics/event oddities: #eng-platform (tag @Logan Wright)
• Email deliverability / unsub spikes / suppression: #marketing-ops (tag @Tyler Benson)
• Support spikes / confusing user reports: #support (tag @Dev Patel) — please link threads/tickets so we can connect to variants

We’ll do a mid-sprint check-in and a final readout week 3. If anything looks off (SLOs, support volume, compliance), we’ll rollback quickly. :thumbsup:

Workflow Bot: Ben Carter pinned a message to this channel.

Marissa Cole: Thanks Ben. Console checklist + banners are behind a feature flag and we’ll start with a small % on day 1. If anyone sees weirdness in Console performance, please screenshot + note the user/org id + approximate time.

Tyler Benson: +1 and for attribution: please don’t share the raw UTM test links outside Redwood (some are holdout-specific). If you need to sanity check a link destination, ping me.

Avery Johnson: For Sales/CS: what’s the “activation” definition we’re using for the headline metric? (We’ve been telling a couple prospects “streaming in <5 min” and don’t want to over-index on the wrong milestone.)

Henry Cho: (jumping in) We’re standardizing on “first_request_success” (first 2xx completion) as the primary activation event for the sprint readout, with “first_streaming_success” as a secondary milestone. We’ll still report a cut on “viewed latency/cost dashboard” since that correlates w/ retention.

Soojin Lee: Re: messaging — please avoid hard latency claims in ad/email copy unless the link points to the benchmark page. If you see any copy that reads like a guarantee, flag it and I’ll adjust.

Dev Patel: Support side: we’ll tag tickets as “LifecycleSprint” and include the user’s last-touch if we can (email vs console banner). If you’re in a customer thread and see onboarding confusion, drop it in #support and link here.

Chloe Martin: Engineering note: there’s a small instrumentation change shipping this week (event props + schema validation). If you see dashboards go weird for a few hours, it may be backfill settling — but still flag it.

Logan Wright: +1. If you’re debugging an event: include the event name + request_id (if available) + whether it was server-side vs console. It helps a ton.

Tessa Morgan: Design/UX — if anyone has opinions on checklist placement (dashboard vs project setup), reply in #design thread, but please keep this #general thread for rollout/ops issues.

Allison Grant: Guardrails: we’ll have alerts on unsubscribe spikes + error banner clicks + support-link clicks. If you get paged on something that looks like sprint-related noise, tag me and we’ll tune thresholds.

Kenji Nakamura: Also: if you notice any nudge copy feels “salesy” vs dev-first, call it out. We have quick copy swaps queued for week 2.

Ben Carter: Great qs. Re: Avery’s point — we’ll keep “streaming success” as a key milestone in the readout, but primary activation = first completed 2xx response. We’ll also share a one-pager FAQ for Sales/CS before launch.

Ben Carter: One more thing: if you’re testing email CTAs, use a fresh test account (not your daily-use org) so we don’t pollute retention slices. :pray:

Dev Patel: :thumbsup: (and please don’t forward the onboarding sequence externally — we’ve had confusion before when folks share drafts)

Tyler Benson: I’ll drop the approved campaign naming + UTM conventions doc in the tracker later today.

Marissa Cole: Launch timing: console nudges v1 expected Tuesday morning PT (after deploy window). We’ll post in #product once the flag starts ramping.

Ben Carter: Appreciate everyone. Keep questions coming in-thread; otherwise, see you at kickoff.
